description: This file defines the ChiSquaredDistribution class, which implements the chi-squared statistical distribution, extending AbstractRealDistribution, and includes methods for density, cumulative probability, mean, variance, and support bounds.

classes.name: ChiSquaredDistribution
classes.description: Implementation of the chi-squared distribution, providing methods for density, cumulative probability, mean, variance, and support bounds.

methods.name: getDegreesOfFreedom
methods.description: Returns the degrees of freedom parameter used in the distribution.

methods.name: density
methods.description: Computes the probability density function at a given value.

methods.name: logDensity
methods.description: Computes the natural logarithm of the density at a given value.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the cumulative distribution function at a given value.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution, equal to the degrees of freedom.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution, equal to 2 times the degrees of freedom.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the distribution's support, always 0.

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the distribution's support, always positive infinity.

methods.name: isSupportLowerBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates whether the support includes its lower bound, always true.

methods.name: isSupportUpperBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates whether the support includes its upper bound, always false.

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the support is a connected interval, always true.
